title: "Remember Thy Creator"
description: "Remember Thy Creator" in Tonic Solfa to EWING, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 1 verses and a piano.
about: Samuel Francis Smith wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 740 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “"Remember thy Creator."”.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens and Sixes Double (7.6.7.6.7.6.7.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to EWING; any other Sevens and Sixes Double tune fits them as well.
underlay: "Re-mem-ber thy Cre-a-tor" While youth's fair spring is bright, Be-fore thy cares are great-er, Be-fore comes a-ge's night; While yet the sun shines o'er thee, While stars the dark-ness cheer, While life is all be-fore thee, Thy great Cre-a-tor fear.

lines: While youth's fair spring is bright,
While yet the sun shines o'er thee,
While life is all before thee,

licence: Public domain: Samuel Francis Smith died in 1895.
credits: Words by Samuel Francis Smith (1808–1895), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to EWING by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
